text:
Jaden Schwartz is 34, in his first season in Colorado, and scoring like a top-six winger in bottom-six minutes. He has seven goals in 18 games at under 14 minutes a night, including two against Chicago on Nov 2.

That pace is borrowed. Seven goals on 3.2 expected (the quality of his chances) means he's shooting 22% against 13% last season, and Colorado is slightly outchanced (49% of the five-on-five expected goals) when he's on the ice. The finishing will cool.

What's real is the fit. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 54% of his shots coming off the rush last season and 67% of his exits leaving the zone with possession, and Evolving-Hockey noted he spent 2025-26 in Seattle with some of the weakest teammates in the league. A depth winger who moves the puck and shoots in transition on a team this fast is a good use of him. Our projection still sees about 21 goals.
